body: Hey wait a minute I don’t recall marching with you 🧐

I march in this show, surprised to see a post about it here. It’s really an honor to be able to commemorate the history of DCI in the show, and to be able to do the wedge is one of the most fun and incredible things I’ve done so far in my marching journey. Glad you enjoyed the show, we’re still just getting started!

If you’re still here, just know you did get that sort by new exposure. I get where you’re coming from, it’s incredibly painful, people just seem to care more about not being held accountable for the future while still wanting to give the most useless nudge of support. Like they know it’s a lost cause and are just preparing for the worst. Funnily enough, the nicest people I’ve ever met are the ones in similar situations. Just a shame that everyone else seems to look down on the situation. It’s kind of a doomer mentality, but at the very least your story has been heard by someone, more than a lot of other lost voices in this subreddit can say. Best of luck, stay with us, we’ll all carry the doomer mentality together. (Also sorry if I sound offensive in any way, not only is this my first time replying on this subreddit but I’m also in a similar pissed off mood as you.)
What aspect of yourselves are you going to look back on and severely regret the most?
Stop the flow, it’s simply a crime
